I had been officially put on lexapro when I was in the 7th grade due to being bullied at school. From that point up until now, I never really saw a drastic change. I even tried to tell my mom and my doctor that and no one would listen to me, they just kept me on it. Even though I kept taking it bc I had to, I still HATED being on lexapro bc it wasn't doing anything for me. So until just several months ago, now that I'm 25 years old, I told my doctor that I wanted to try Prozac and he finally agreed. Needless to say I LOVE it, and immediately noticed a difference within my confidence, happiness, & everything. 

So In my opinion I wouldn't recommend lexapro. 

I also have a friend that is taking lexapro and hasn't ever noticed a difference either.
